what: Proposed stderr sanitization runs after read has already split on newline, so the newline-injection part of Item B remains unhandled
scenario_or_breakage: A gh stderr payload containing attacker-controlled LF still produces multiple larch_err records before sanitize_diagnostic_line sees the data, allowing forged or confusing extra log lines
suggested_fix: Sanitize or encode tmp_stderr as a byte stream before line splitting, or intentionally collapse normalized stderr to a bounded single diagnostic record; update the regression to assert injected LF cannot create extra larch_err records

what: Proposed tr -d '[:cntrl:]' helper is locale-dependent rather than a deterministic byte sanitizer
scenario_or_breakage: On macOS/BSD in a UTF-8 locale, malformed non-UTF-8 bytes from untrusted gh stderr can make tr report illegal byte sequence or produce inconsistent filtering
suggested_fix: Define the helper with LC_ALL=C tr -d '[:cntrl:]' and add a regression covering malformed high bytes plus valid UTF-8 pass-through
